curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Flynn holds the trail to King Solomon's Mines, but deciphering the path requires a relic hidden deep within Moroccan ruins.
curatedMovie.description: After a map leading to King Solomon's Mines is stolen, librarian Flynn Carsen must track down a vital cipher piece in Morocco while staying one step ahead of ruthless mercenaries seeking the legendary site.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, light, and exciting globe-trotting adventure built on archaeological puzzles and brisk escapes.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Jonathan Frakes directs an energetic, fast-moving quest filled with ancient ruins, narrow escapes, and lighthearted globe-trotting adventure.

facts.title: The Librarian: Return to King Solomon's Mines
